# DeepLabV3+ (ResNet-101)

Semantic Segmentation · `deeplabv3plus-resnet101_512x512` · DX-APP Python example

Semantic Segmentation model, evaluated on PascalVOC2012.

**Input** 512 × 512 × 3 · **Dataset** PascalVOC2012 · **License** MIT · **Quantization** Q-Lite, Q-Pro

![DeepLabV3+ (ResNet-101) output](result.webp)

Full card with copy buttons and dark/light theme (open it in a browser; GitHub shows its source): [model.html](model.html)

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models DeepLabV3PlusResNet101-1
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/semantic_segmentation/deeplabv3/deeplabv3plus-resnet101_512x512/deeplabv3plus-resnet101_512x512_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/deeplabv3plus-resnet101_512x512.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_parking.jpg
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target deeplabv3plus-resnet101_512x512_sync   # once
./bin/deeplabv3plus-resnet101_512x512_sync \
  -m assets/models/deeplabv3plus-resnet101_512x512.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_parking.jpg
```

## Accuracy

| Quantization | mIoU |
|---|---:|
| Raw · ONNX | 76.09 |
| Q-Lite | 75.78 (−0.31) |
| Q-Pro | 76.04 (−0.05) |

PascalVOC2012 · difference vs Raw in brackets.
